reasoning: The landscape plan vision analysis shows trees proposed along the southern boundary appearing to be very close (less than 5 feet) to the overhead electric (OHE) line. I need to measure the lateral distances from the tree planting locations to the OHE conductor to determine if they comply with UCM § 1.10.10.4 distribution clearance requirements (15 feet minimum for utility-compatible trees, 25 feet for large trees). These measurements will determine pass/fail for EL-2.1, EL-2.3, and potentially EL-2.14.
